rules: construct names only: vlan, mac-vrf, ip-vrf, acl
every node and port in the device's own naming, and served only when it resolves in the site inventory
served only when every key in requires is qualified in the fabric qualification record (absent = unqualified)

prompts.prompt: Create vlan 120 on leaf01 ethernet-1/1 for tenant acme
Extend vlan 100 as a mac-vrf across leaf01 ethernet-1/1 and leaf02 ethernet-1/1 for tenant blue
Create an ip-vrf for tenant initech carrying 10.50.0.0/24 at leaf01 ethernet-1/1 vlan 200
Extend vlan 130 as a mac-vrf across leaf01 ethernet-1/1 and leaf02 ethernet-1/1 with an anycast gateway 10.30.0.1/24 for tenant blue
Add an ingress ipv4 acl on leaf01 ethernet-1/1 vlan 120 for tenant acme that permits tcp to port 443 and denies everything else
Create vlan 140 on leaf01 ethernet-1/1 for tenant acme with an ingress ipv4 acl that denies udp to port 53
